title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw a two-dimensional sketch consisting of a closed loop. Start by drawing the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0), then draw the second line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0426), followed by the third line from (0.75, 0.0426) to (0.0341, 0.0426), and finally the fourth line from (0.0341, 0.0426) back to the origin (0.0, 0.0). Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.75. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the same Euler angles and translating it with the same vector. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.0426 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. This will result in a cylindrical object with a rectangular cross-section and rounded edges, measuring 0.75 units in length, 0.0426 units in width, and 0.0426 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0426) \
     .lineTo(0.0341, 0.0426) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0426)

# The final model
r  # This will display the final model

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

X = 0.7500
Y = 0.0426
Z = 0.0426
CH = 0.030  # chamfer size at one end (in plan view)

# Main bar starting after the chamfered region
bar = cq.Workplane("XY").box(X - CH, Y, Z, centered=False).translate((CH, 0, 0))

# Wedge that fills the chamfered end (sloped face visible in TOP view)
wedge = (cq.Workplane("XY")
         .polyline([(0, 0), (CH, 0), (CH, Y), (0, Y)]).close()
         .extrude(Z))

r = bar.union(wedge)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Beam with a chamfered (45° bevel) end, seen in the TOP view.
# The cross-section perpendicular to Z is a square (RIGHT view),
# so the profile is sketched in the XY plane and extruded along Z.

# Profile points in the XY plane (X along length, Y across width):
# (0, 0) -> (0.75, 0) -> (0.75, 0.0426) -> (0.0225, 0.0426) -> close
# The closing edge from (0.0225, 0.0426) to (0, 0) forms the 45° chamfer.

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .polyline([
        (0.0, 0.0),
        (0.75, 0.0),
        (0.75, 0.0426),
        (0.0225, 0.0426),
    ])
    .close()
    .extrude(0.0426)
)
